sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fire Release, Lightning Release

system.description:
You summon orbs of plasma and use them to cover your hands and feet like gauntlets and grieves and blend into the light your plasma creates. Select up to 2 Starlight’s you’ve created within 60 feet of you. You teleport into a space within the light the Starlight radiates, and make a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against a creature in range, dealing 6d6 fire damage on a hit. If you are in your Solar Flare stance, you can add your Plasma Burst damage.

Creatures you deal damage to as a result of this jutsu must make a Constitution saving throw, being marked with Convergence until the end of your next turn on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can select up to 3 Starlight’s teleporting to each as part of this jutsu’s casting.
